t: This Fortress Trade 4" Flat Masonry Paint Brush is specifically designed for applying masonry paints on exterior surfaces. Engineered for professional decorators and builders, it is ideal for tackling extensive outdoor projects such as rendering, brickwork, and general wall coatings. Its wide head and synthetic, mixed filaments provide superb paint pick-up and release, significantly reducing tramlines for a consistently smooth finish. Featuring a robust, rust-resistant stainless steel ferrule and an ergonomic handle, it offers comfortable use and durability. The brush is also quick and easy to clean, ensuring prolonged efficiency.
